notes.title: New Release! Get ZHive for $1.79 (-40%)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone

We have launched another wallet friendly game...Zhive!

Zhive is a small and simple strategy game where you command the undead on the map by selecting the areas where you want them to spawn and then direct them to a target area. But be careful, think strategically. The soldiers are well equipped and can decimate your minions with ease. Don't let them roam around, they could restock and find the survivor!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/110f5f3f7069ae9cbfabe596cf19ef9930b577e5.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119530/ZHIVE/

notes.title: New Game! "Dragon Chase" is now available! [30% Off]
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone

We present you another wallet friendly game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/12778fd3b1a12f568afb01ab807460b43d6f7ab3.gif[/img]

Dragon chase is a small game hybrid between a platformer and a runner where you take the control of a knight being chased by a Dragon. Avoid being ripped by the Dragon, dodge traps and fend off enemies on a randomized environment.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/2a93ff5bfa7254f187d80e6a3ddb0db69642cdc1.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/a61cbf4432bd6f238238e78c518f3d8277eb5aab.gif[/img]

Dragon Chase is available for just 2 dollars and currently has a launch discount of 30%. We recommend you to get Dragon Chase if you would like to enjoy a quick challenge. We hope you can support us with your purchase.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011240/Dragon_Chase/

Thanks and have fun :)

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Time Splatter 1.0.3 is now online[/h1]

A small but no less important update has been implemented.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Leaderboard Fix[/b] - We have fixed the formatting of the leaderboard as well the scoring. Due to this, the leaderboard has been reset but now everyone can now score in properly.
[*][b]Volume and SFX Options[/b] - Volume and SFX options have been added but we are still making a couple tweaks.
[*][b]Minor bug fixes.[/b] 
[/list]

[h1]Future Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Invert Axis Fix[/b] - Inverting the mouse axis is not properly working yet.
[*][b]Chapter 2[/b] - We are working on the next chapter.
[/list]

We hope that you enjoyed chapter 1 and that you look forward to chapter 2.

Thanks!

notes.title: First Post!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone

We present you yet another wallet friendly game.

Time Splatter is an episodic rails shooter game. At release, only chapter 1 will be available, but we plan to release another two chapters, one per month, all free. Maybe more if the game does well.

While we believe that Time Splatter won't blow your heads due to awesomeness, it is an experience worth enough the 60 cents it is selling for right now. Even if you don't think so, it will be once the next chapters come out. But I am just a humble community manager lol, check it out and tell us.

As the concepts stand, the second chapter will take place inside the castle and will release around Christmas. Yes... free.

We are working in an update that will fix and add a couple things like being able to invert the mouse axis and tweak some audio settings. It will come out at some point during the next 24 hours.

Thanks for playing!
